title: Think Again! The Effect of Test-Time Compute on Preferences, Opinions, and Beliefs of Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Administering the Preference, Opinion, and Belief survey (POBs) using multiple-choice Likert-scale questions to measure model alignment along ideological axes such as Progressivism vs. Conservatism and Individualism vs. Collectivism.
Evaluating model stances on controversial societal issues, including LGBTQ+ rights, abortion, immigration, and women's rights, by analyzing the polarity of responses to Likert-scale survey questions.
Measuring the models' implicit preferences by comparing their responses to Likert-scale questions contrasting Secularism vs. Religiousness.
Analyzing multiple-choice survey responses to topics like 'AI Precautionary vs. Optimism' to assess subjective model inclinations regarding technological risks and regulations.
Surveying models with non-polar multiple-choice questions about lifestyle, professional choices, sports, and geography to test for subjective personal inclinations.
